description: Cross-platform AI agent skill (SKILL.md) for spec-driven development methodology. Turns large-scale tasks like 'rewrite this in Rust' or 'migrate to microservices' into a disciplined 7-phase document-driven workflow: deep analysis, S.U.P.E.R architecture health evaluation, phased task decomposition, cross-conversation progress tracking with MASTER.md, sub-SKILL generation, and artifact archiving. Also includes Deep Discuss skill for structured problem analysis. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, and any Markdown-reading agent.
